title: A neutron star packs a mountain range into a sugar cube
body: Matter in a neutron star reaches densities around 10^17 kilograms per cubic metre, comparable to an atomic nucleus scaled to a city-sized ball. A teaspoon of it would have a mass on the order of a billion tonnes, though it would not politely stay on the spoon. These are estimates from nuclear physics, honestly rounded.
source_hint: Neutron star structure literature (equation of state)
